# Aniket Patidar

This is the personal website of Aniket Patidar, a software engineer living in India. 
The site primarily contains blog posts about Ruby, Ruby on Rails, and software engineering.

## When to use this site
- You need information about Aniket Patidar, his projects, or his professional background.
- You are looking for articles, tutorials, or opinions on Ruby on Rails.
- You need contact information or a summary of his experience.

## Site Structure
- `/`: The homepage with a brief introduction.
- `/about/`: More detailed information about Aniket.
- `/contact/`: How to get in touch.
- `/privacy/`: Privacy policy and terms.
- `/projects/`: A list of projects.
- `/sitemap.xml`: Full map of all pages.

## Agent Guidelines
Please respect robots.txt. Markdown representations of pages are available via standard content negotiation.
